checks.detail: No filter -> total=20 and printer-318469 present. min_price=0 -> total=19 and printer-318469 absent. max_price branch also excludes it (both branches locked, not just min). q='may in'+min_price=0 -> 3 (R2 x R4 intersection).

checks.name: r5_total_before_slicing
checks.detail: page_size=10 -> total=20 AND len(items)=10. page=2 shares zero ids with page=1. page=3 -> (total=20, items=[]) with no raise (decision #13). category=refrigerator -> total=4 not 20, proving d['total'] did not leak (RK8).

checks.name: x1_is_not_none_trap_rk16
checks.detail: THE fourth silent-200 mode, and the hardest to catch. category='' -> total=0 (NOT 20). DISCRIMINATION PROVEN: subagent flipped step 2 to `if category:` -> the test failed with `assert 20 == 0`, then restored byte-identical (md5 f666dbf3f3d7bcf0cfeef353af559175 both sides). Note category='bogus' gives 0 under BOTH implementations because 'bogus' is truthy -- it slips straight through the hole, which is exactly why the empty string is the only discriminating case. brand='' -> 0 likewise. Code gates on the RAW param then filters with a possibly-None resolved slug, so an unresolvable category yields 0 rather than skipping the filter.

checks.name: x2_inclusive_price_bound_rk19
checks.detail: min_price=3290000 -> total=19. DISCRIMINATION PROVEN: subagent flipped the bound to strict '>' -> test failed with `assert 17 == 19`, then restored byte-identical. The dataset's lowest effective price is exactly 3290000, which is why this is the only separating case; min_price=0 yields 19 under BOTH comparisons and locks nothing (VL-15).

checks.name: sort_contract
checks.detail: First id air-conditioner-335837, last tablet-345544. Differs from file order (which starts refrigerator-358160), confirming the sort-by-id contract is independent of file serialization.

checks.name: a10_fold_identity_search_tier
checks.detail: app.search.fold is app.text.fold -> True (verified independently). Second site where fold could have been duplicated, since brand filtering needs it.

checks.name: no_mutation
checks.detail: dataset.products id list byte-identical after many run() combinations. Filtering uses new lists; sorting uses sorted() not .sort().

checks.name: a11_pure_layer_no_http
checks.detail: grep -rnE 'fastapi|starlette' app/ -> 0 lines across the ENTIRE app/ package. The pure layer is complete and knows nothing about HTTP.

checks.name: glossary_compliance
checks.detail: FINDING (criterion defect, not a code defect): the phase's literal check `grep -rniE 'search.index|inverted.index' app/` reports 1 hit at app/loader.py:2 -- but that is a FALSE POSITIVE. The unescaped '.' in the regex matches '/', so ordinary Vietnamese prose 'tang search/index.' trips it. Re-run with a literal separator class (`search[ _-]index|inverted[ _-]index`) -> 0 lines. No glossary violation exists. This is the FIFTH imprecise grep-based criterion found in this plan (after A10, A12, phase-1's pythonpath test, and A11's prose-matching); the pattern is systemic and is being surfaced to the user.
